lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 8 distinct white vertical lines are visible; spacing is narrower in the anterior section (near the shoulder) and widens significantly toward the posterior torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The second and third lines from the anterior are truncated, terminating at the mid-lateral torso; the fourth line is dashed and lacks continuity through the mid-section.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 4 to 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior hind limb, positioned superior to the hock.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, emerging at an approximate 45-degree posterior angle from the frontal bone before curving slightly inward at the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 1.5 times the combined pixel width of the two horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on the distal 25% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal chevron between the orbital regions and a distinct white fringe along the dorsal line from the neck to the rump.
